newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nail plans one bln rand rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Nail plans one bln rand rights issue.

text.p: New Africa Investments Ltd (Nail) said on Friday it plans to raise around one billion rand, before expenses, by way of a renounceable rights offer to Nail shareholders.
Black investment group Nail said the last day to register for the issue was August 15.
Full details of the proposed offer would be announced on Monday, August 11.

Nail is currently in talks with South African mining house Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd and its Driefontein Consolidated Ltd unit to buy their shareholdings in Asteroid Ltd, which holds 40 percent of GFSA Holdings Ltd.

The deal, if successful, would mark a further big advance for black business in South Africa -- and a significant coup for Nail which already has control of industrial group Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd.
Gold Fields is the world's third biggest gold producer.
